notes.title: 😈💀 Free DLC Update! 👩🏼‍🦰🤖
notes.notes:
[h2]Happy Halloween Forever from all of us at Poppy Works![/h2]

We're happy to be able to bring you this new Free DLC and language update this year. We hope you enjoy unlocking the new characters and checking out all of what they have in store for you in the world of Halloween Forever.
 
[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]

[b][u]New Languages[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Portuguese
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[/list]

[b][u]Added[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [img]https://i.imgur.com/SFofGul.png [/img] New Character: [b]Ms. Succubus[/b]
[*] [img]https://i.imgur.com/FiLmK5f.png[/img] New Character: [b]Harmonia [/b](guest character from "[url=https://amon26.itch.io/ausable]Au Sable[/url]")
[*] [img]https://i.imgur.com/bWKidFr.png[/img] New Character: [b]Protagonist [/b](guest character from "[url=https://amon26.itch.io/aoofad]All Our Friends Are Dead[/url]")
[*] [img]https://i.imgur.com/ib2fWxw.png[/img] New Character: [b]Rae [/b](guest character from "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753440/A_Small_Robot_Story/]A Small Robot Story[/url]") 
[*] New sound effects were added to make the world feel more lively~!
[*] PC and Console 4:3/16:9 settings. [i]If you play on PC, press F9 to change the game's aspect ratio!![/i]
[/list]

[u][b]Fixed[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where lives would reset to 1 after death. Reality now contains many lives.
[*] Frogs are now optimized. Don't ask.
[*] Fixed a Character Select Screen input bug.
[*] Fixed audio issues for PC and PS4 players.
[*] Increased game stability.
[*] Fixed audio volume issues on some platforms
[*] Fixed an issue with displaying some secret text has been addressed.
[*] Fixed a Lives Counter drawing issue.
[/list]

Changed
[list]
[*] Save file layout to accomidate the new characters.
[/list]

Additionally, a special Karaoke version of the Halloween Forever theme song will be live on all all music services starting on October 30th!

[previewyoutube=QI3Lc7KSwEs;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Happy Halloween Forever![/i]

notes.title: Version 1.7
notes.notes:
A big thanks to our community for pointing out various issues with the 1.6 update. Below, you'll find our additions and fixes to the game that will create a more enjoyable experience. Please continue to let us know if there are any other issues or suggestions you have!

[list]
[*] Added: "Exit" button to Main Menu.
[*] Added: "Return" option to the Pause menu, allowing easy restarts.
[*] Fixed: Missing characters in the Simplified Chinese font.
[*] Fixed: Languages not loading if the Player did not have Steam Overlay enabled.
[*] Believe Fixed: Issues with Steam Achievements not proc-ing. Issue related to Steam Overlay option.
[*] Fixed: Upon Game Over, the game retained some odd stats, such as Rune progress and Player lives. This is resolved.
[*] Fixed: Screenshake camera placement issue.
[*] Updated: Screen resolution more stable.
[/list]

We are additionally planning on allowing users access to a legacy version of the game for the purposes of speedrunning. We will share that info as soon as it's ready~!


Thanks a lot!

Happy Halloween Forever~!

notes.title: v1.6 - Input and new update~!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11553601/4e03fe4820da5d9b5994098964cc5239144c9324.png[/img]

Hello everyone~!
Wolfgang Wozniak from Poppy Works here, we are now the global publisher for Halloween Forever, including on Steam~! We wanted to update the game to support new languages as well as improve stability. This update makes it easier for us to add new languages at any time, and improves overall game stability. We ran this update with the Imaginary Monster Discord community in a beta program and did not come across any issues. 

Well, what is this? The patch notes can be found below!

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese language
[*] Korean language
[*] Mandarin Chinese language
[*] New save/load system
[*] Steam Cloud save
[*] Gamepad support improved
[*] Cursor is now hidden when gamepad buttons are pressed
[*] Official Boo Dudes song "Halloween Forever" to the Credits screen.
[*] New font "Silver". Get it at https://poppyworks.itch.io/silver
[/list]

[b]Updated[/b]
[list]
[*] Entire game's script is loaded externally. Modding is possible.
[*] Map arrow is now animated
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Removed[/b]
[list]
[*] Button remapping (This will come back at a later date. Please use Steam Big Picture to remap your controls for now)
[/list]

We removed the previous button remapping system as it was a little unstable and unpredictable. We've also implemented our own input system into the game. Button remapping will return very soon, as we are in development on a new system that we can use across all of our GMS projects, such as this one. 
We've also reworked the entire saving and loading system, but made sure to give Steam players who have unlocked the Achievements on Steam before a way to ensure that the characters they've unlocked will be retained in this new update. The new saving and loading system is more stable, and is compliant with console systems, and should improve stability on lower-end PC systems. This update will be available on Mac OSX later this week.

We hope that you enjoy our new work, and if you have any issues, please be sure to post them in the Steam Community. We will be monitoring it for any issues this new update has created.

Thank you very much and [i]Happy Halloween [u]Forever[/u][/i]~!

notes.title: Tiny Update: v. 1.104 simultaneous gamepad + keyboard, and Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11553601/f7798ca88b5600f79d21f534879893901ffecd1b.jpg[/img]
Hey folks. There's a small update to the build today fixing an old issue preventing keyboard controls from working if you have a gamepad / controller plugged in. There have been some issues with some users having multiple controllers plugged in or partially supported controllers plugged in not being able to play the game at all since keyboard controls would be trying to map to the gamepad. Now both can work at the same time, gamepad AND keyboard. This should help people from getting locked out from playing the game at all if their device setup is unique or extensive. Lock up your cats! Also if you find some epic speedrun strats that involve gamepad and keyboard at the same time, be my guest.

This is the beginning of hopefully better input support and ux with Halloween Forever (and future games). This seemed like the lowest hanging fruit for something I could take care of in an evening. More to come.

In other news, 

[h1]Trading Cards are live![/h1]
Better late than never! I kept the card set to 5 so it would be easier to collect them. Also I found another use for the Halloween Forever minicomic artwork I made almost a year ago. Anyway, enjoy them! Happy collecting, selling, and trading : ]

notes.title: Holiday Update: Santa Pumpkin! v.1.102
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11553601/763d96d9def9a2baee907bcd1883f6c12e03930f.jpg[/img]
Happy Holidays from Halloween Forever! 

As a little Christmas gift you can play as Santa Pumpkin (unlocked by default). Also the beginnings of some new game menu organization is in with room for new features. Stuff like full screen toggle is yet to come but there's room to have it in now.

Door-hit-fall-through-the-world glitching should be fixed now too.

There might be some gamepad control issues happening with the new update that I haven't had a chance to pinpoint yet (one tester reported having jump and fire being switched but controls worked the same for me). If you see this too feel free to let me know and I'll start looking into it.

The Grizzledude sprite is a tease for now (he isn't in yet...this was the only Santa Pumpkin image I have and I'm posting this from my phone!) but I do want to add him soon. Adding characters is fun and measurable task right now. Expect some more updates like this and some of those long discussed quality of life features in early 2017.

Thanks folks! Happy Holidays! See ya in 2017 🌝

notes.title: October release plans and future thoughts
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11553601/dd6394f7a4ed94a9ac44d4a3c5567f52fa6aa003.gif[/img]
Hey all,

It's nearly Halloween 2016! I've gone way past my completion estimate of Summer 2016 at this point, but the end is in sight for Halloween Forever progressing toward final. I still have some work to do but I'm working hard to have the game wrapped up this month. I keep talking to people directly and on Twitch about release schedule stuff but it's time to just make some of these dates public. If all goes well here's what we are looking at:

10/14: Bosses and levels should be content complete by now. This might spill into the weekend. I'll still need to get achievements and a few other characters hooked in at this point. Secondary goal to the 10/14 date is to have a version ready we can send off to reviewers with some time left before release.

10/19: Everything should be mostly finished. Going to try giving myself some time between then and launch for polish and testing. 

10/26: Target release day! Just in time for Halloween. This could go live sooner if it turns out we're ready to go early.

On top of dates, Eric Lewis / Indie Luchador is going to be giving me a hand with PR efforts during and after release. This will help me getting the word out a ton.

I wanted to give everybody a heads up over a future price change too. Looking back at my original scope plan for Halloween Forever in Early Access, I'm realizing that I've exceeded that by a bit. For one thing, there are going to be 10 bosses in the final version, not 5. Also the unlockable characters add some fun and variety to replay. So here's the details:

- Halloween Forever will stay 2.99 as long as it's in Early Access.
- When it leaves EA, the price will go up to 4.99 (minus a launch discount)
- If you already have the game, you're all set!
- Timing remains unseen, but I do want to continue adding additional fun stuff to Halloween Forever post launch. The way I make updates will be a little different since it won't be EA anymore. Less sweeping big things and more filling in gaps, adding interest. I have ideas for how I can add in some good new secrets and level branches without disrupting the core flow. Also new character unlocks are very measured and easy to scope in.

I'm daydreaming of a nice Halloween 2017 update but that's so long away from now...

I'm going to work on getting all of the messaging consistent on the Steam pages coming up. Any questions, don't hesitate to reach out. Thanks to everybody who has been checking through the build and communicating bugs and issues back to me. I'm hoping to have an intermediate build or two out in between dates to start addressing things people have been reporting.

Stay creepy!
